title: Dijkstra mutual exclusion safety model
summary: A PlusCal-derived TLA+ state-transition model for Dijkstra's mutual exclusion algorithm. The generated four-process configuration checks the invariant that no two distinct processes are simultaneously at control point cs.

source.statement:
MutualExclusion == \A i, j \in Proc :
                     (i # j) => ~ /\ pc[i] = "cs"
                                  /\ pc[j] = "cs"

assumptions: Proc is the finite set of process values supplied by MC.tla (p1 through p4 in the packaged configuration).
Spec uses Init, stuttering steps over Next, and weak fairness for each P(self); fairness is part of the behavior specification, while MutualExclusion is a state invariant.

license.attribution: The dijkstra-mutex manifest attributes the specification to Leslie Lamport. The repository LICENSE.md names the TLA+ project and other contributors.

reuse: Download a retained two-process or three-process model/configuration bundle. Keep DijkstraMutex.tla unchanged. With tla2tools 1.7.4 and the recorded checksum, run java -Xmx512m -cp tla2tools-1.7.4.jar tlc2.TLC -workers 1 -config MC.cfg MC.tla. Choose the finite Proc set in the generated MC model and configuration for each new instance.
